completion_decisions: Retain the fictitious 2x3, Stags Holt/Coldham and Middelgrunden problems and all five paper-native SLP, SGA and SGA-to-SLP roles.
Use the paper-cited Risoe-R-1768 report for missing SGA/SLP parameters, real-site polygons, wind resources, turbine facts and iteration counts.
Use the report's 83.9% and 89.4% baseline efficiencies as case-wide wake calibration anchors only; never calibrate to optimized results.
Use the pinned OpenWAKE lineage Middelgrunden coordinates and declared figure digitizations for Stags and the fictitious case.
Reconstruct the absent HAWC2-DWM load table analytically while retaining the paper component-cost, Wohler, degradation and maintenance structure.
Parallelize wind states, complete SGA layouts and SLP trial layouts through one deterministic persistent pure-C++ team.
Execute one native run per role plus an explicitly labelled 25-seed robustness extension for each stochastic role.
missing_information: HAWTOPT source, SLP state and original MATLAB working-horse code
7500 HAWC2-DWM simulations, six Mann-seed time series and exact 4D load database
S2MW curve files and complete real-site bathymetry and coordinate arrays
fictitious-case numeric arrays, maintenance distribution parameters and exact random state

paper.authors: Pierre‐Elouan Réthoré and Peter Fuglsang and Gunner C. Larsen and Thomas Buhl and Torben J. Larsen and Helge A. Madsen
paper.title: TOPFARM: Multi-Fidelity Optimization of Wind Farms

paper_source_conflicts: The paper states 1D blade-contact spacing while noting standards require more than 2D; the paper-native 1D benchmark is retained and explicitly scoped.
The report Appendix input MaxIteNr is 250 while result sections state 1000 SGA plus 20/30 SLP iterations; result-section native lifecycles control reproduction.
The report cable table contains a unit/value typographic inconsistency; the journal's explicit 675 EUR/m offshore and 270 EUR/m onshore values control reproduction.
Current TopFarm2 is later public lineage and is not represented as the unavailable 2014 HAWTOPT/MATLAB source.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reproduction of the three problems, financial objective and five native SGA/SLP roles; not author HAWTOPT, HAWC2-DWM database, complete site arrays, random stream or exact trajectory

constraints_and_repair.resolution: paper-native polygon boundaries and one-rotor-diameter blade-contact spacing; SGA duplicate rule and deterministic SLP projection/spacing repair retained

decision_variables.resolution: one candidate index per turbine for level-1 SGA and continuous x/y coordinates for level-2 SLP

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: binary candidate-index chromosome for SGA; direct continuous coordinates for SLP

initialization.resolution: fictitious and Stags layouts are declared figure digitizations; Middelgrunden uses pinned OpenWAKE lineage coordinates

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: five native roles with one unreported native run; 25 deterministic reconstruction seeds for each stochastic role; all objective parts, feasibility, FES, timing and hashes recorded

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize 20-year financial balance of energy value minus fatigue degradation and maintenance minus financed variable foundation and cable investment

paper_native_cases.resolution: six-turbine fictitious offshore, 17-turbine Stags onshore and 20-turbine Middelgrunden offshore cases with five native algorithm roles

parameters.resolution: population 20, crossover 0.70, mutation 0.025, two elites, scaling 2, report move-limit range and native generation/iteration counts

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 150 or 1000 SGA generations and 50, 30 or 20 SLP iterations; every complete layout evaluation counted

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: T58 has no trained learning model

update_order.resolution: SGA generations and SLP iterations remain ordered; population and trial outputs use fixed slots before ordered commits

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Larsen stationary wake with linear superposition and rotor quadrature, paper financial equations and transparent analytic replacement for missing HAWC2-DWM load table

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 144 fine direction-speed states from report arrays and a fixed 36-state probability-preserving coarse aggregation
